text:
Type: solid birch wooden stool
Use: extra seating at a table, bedside or plant stand; dining room, kitchen, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, farmhouse
Materials: solid birch with a clear lacquer finish, visible joinery pegs
Colors: pale natural birch, warm off-white wood
Shape: rectangular seat with softly rounded corners, deep apron, four splayed square legs, low H-shaped stretcher, sturdy and compact
Feel: warm, natural, honest, calm
Goes with: light wood tables, white walls, linen, ceramics; Scandinavian, Japandi or farmhouse dining rooms

product.name: NORRKER
product.description: Durable and hard-wearing; meets the requirements on furniture for public use.
